assets.name: diagram-01-bounded-cycle-wide
assets.caption: The arrangement I’m testing: one bounded assignment moves through execution and review, while the dot prepares independent next proposals and surfaces ready owner decisions. Dependent work still waits for approval. Wait only when no useful permitted action remains, with an owner answer, task result or agreed check named as the resumption trigger.

Wait only if no useful permitted action remains, with an owner answer, task result or agreed check named as the resumption trigger.

assets.name: diagram-02-recovery-wide
assets.caption: Recover from the last confirmed state. Perform a known safe step within approval; seek an owner decision if a consequential submission is uncertain or scope must change. The owner may hold. If proceeding, perform the approved next step, then inspect the actual result before marking complete. Never blindly duplicate a submission.
assets.alt_text: A missing result triggers inspection of the last confirmed state. Assess whether continuation is known, safe and within approval. If so, perform that known safe step. An uncertain consequential submission or changed scope goes to the owner, who may approve the next step or keep it on hold. Only if proceeding, perform the approved step, then inspect the actual result. A held step does not lead to execution. Attempted does not mean verified. Never blindly duplicate a submission.

prompts.cover01: Use case: illustration-story. Create a premium editorial cover illustration for a thoughtful first-person essay about learning to give a ChatGPT dot useful ongoing work. Use the attached official ChatGPT Dots reference image only to preserve the distinctive CORAL ORANGE SCALLOPED ROUND CHARACTER with glossy black eyes and one black monocle, and the warm coral / cream / soft lavender product vocabulary. Recompose the entire scene as original editorial art, NOT a screenshot and not official advertising. Wide 16:9 composition. In a tactile clay-and-paper still life, a small coral scalloped monocle character sits at a curved cream desk on the right half. One cream paper packet with a simple small check rests flat beside it, while the character thoughtfully PRESENTS two cream proposal cards upright toward a partial human hand reaching from the upper right; the hand is poised to choose, has NOT chosen yet. Cards have only abstract dark lines and blank circular decision markers; NO written words, numbers, logos, app windows or UI buttons. Visual idea: completed work was easy; surfacing the next useful choice is the missing coordination. Use exquisite soft material rendering, fine paper grain, warm side light, sophisticated coral shadow, subtle lavender desk edge and charcoal details. Bold identifiable mascot silhouette with monocle unobscured. Leave the left 42 percent quiet pale cream negative space for later editorial typography. No circular arrows, no flywheel, no generic loop, no robots, no office stock imagery, no claims of continuous autonomous work. Three-dimensional editorial craft, art-directed magazine quality, visually warm but restrained.
prompts.cover02: Use case: illustration-story. An original premium editorial conceptual cover for an essay about ChatGPT dots and learning to coordinate delegated work. Use the attached official product image as a reference for the distinctive small CORAL ORANGE SCALLOPED ROUND MASCOT with black eyes and one black monocle, preserving that recognizable character identity. Entirely new art-directed composition, not product UI or screenshot. Wide16:9. Overhead view of a beautiful cream-paper desk on a soft lavender ground. At the center-right the small coral mascot is at a branching junction of THREE paper strips: a finished cream manuscript with a small charcoal check at lower left, a CORAL CHOICE CARD with two empty decision circles held up upright at upper right, and an unopened stack of future work at bottom right. An elegant realistic partial human hand comes in from the top edge hovering above the choice card, visibly not having chosen. The composition must make the difference between finished output and a decision waiting to be surfaced legible without text. Rich tactile paper, editorial still life, sculpted monochrome cream objects, delicate shadows, sophisticated graphic hierarchy, subtle grain. Leave top left third mostly empty lavender for later title. NO readable text, NO circular loop or flywheel, NO robots, NO logos, NO fake screenshots, no continuous-autonomy claim. Shape language and coral cream lavender palette grounded in the supplied real ChatGPT Dots source.
prompts.cover03: Use case: illustration-story. Create an original high-end magazine cover illustration about a new ChatGPT dot assistant needing a clearer next decision. Attached official reference shows the real distinctive CORAL SCALLOPED ROUND MASCOT with black eyes and one black monocle: use that recognizable character, not a generic AI robot. New widescreen16:9 scene. Architectural miniature in warm cream and coral: a very small cream stage on the lower right, coral monocle dot standing attentively beside TWO tall cream proposal cards presented at the stage edge. Each card has an elegant hollow dark circle and 2 simple dark abstract lines, no text. A finished paper manuscript with a small check lies behind the character. Above them a beautifully sculpted partial human hand hovers, poised to make the next choice. A soft pale lavender arc of light illuminates the decision cards; the rest is calm spacious creamy background. Use strong scale contrast, coral mascot as focal point, warm matte clay sculpture and paper texture, sophisticated museum-like editorial photograph, dimensional but restrained, no distracting detail. Left45percent remains blank cream negative space for later headline. It must feel like a human-and-dot working relationship, uncertain next choice, not infinite productivity. NO words, numbers, app chrome, UI buttons, arrows, loops, generic robots, logos or official advertising.
prompts.cover01_portrait: Recompose this exact editorial illustration into a tall 4:5 PORTRAIT cover. Preserve the recognizable coral scalloped round mascot with its black monocle and both cream proposal cards with undecided hollow circles, the small completed manuscript bearing a check, the partial human hand poised above cards, and warm paper-and-clay textures. Do not crop away either card or the hand. Keep the complete character and decision scene in the LOWER TWO THIRDS of the portrait, arranged compactly on the curved cream and lavender desk. TOP THIRD is quiet pale cream negative space to hold editorial typography later. Preserve warm coral gradient side lighting. No written text, logos, buttons, app chrome or new objects. This is conceptual editorial art based on the ChatGPT Dots product mascot, not an official screenshot or a personal avatar.
